Load Sequences from NCBI GenBank with Metadata from INSD XML Files

load_insd.Rd

Load Sequences from NCBI GenBank with Metadata from INSD XML Files

Usage

load_insd(path, recursive = TRUE, regex = NULL)

Arguments

path

Character vector. Path to a directory or to XML files. If a directory path is provided, matching XML files are loaded.

recursive

Logical. When path is a directory, whether to search for XML files recursively. Default is TRUE.

regex

Character or NULL. Optional regular expression passed to pattern in list.files() when path is a directory.

Value

A data.frame containing parsed INSD fields plus three derived columns:

zbarc.voucher

Specimen voucher extracted from source_specimen_voucher or source_isolate.

zbarc.organism_id

Specimen identifier derived from source_organism and zbarc.voucher.

zbarc.gene

Gene/locus label detected from INSDSeq_definition (cytochrome, 18S, 28S, 16S, or fallback INSDSeq_definition).

See also

Other insd: .read_insd()
